blocks.content: You've explored how alert rules appear in the Grafana UI.

**What you explored:**

- The alert rules list organized by folders and evaluation groups
- How to expand a rule to see its instances
- The difference between rule state (Normal, Pending, Firing) and health (Ok, Error, No Data)
- How to filter and search the rules list
You now have a mental map of where alerting concepts live in the UI. In the next course module, you'll explore how the notification system delivers alerts to the right people.
